name: Garden bed 1
notes:
Garden bed beside the sauna and cacao guild: the damp herb carpet bed, fed by mister and roof runoff.
Build: hügelkultur base of punky Blackbutt scraps, compost, then 10–15 cm coarse wood chip; optionally mix mushroom grain spawn into fresh chip for a mulch-bed crop.
Plants: cardamom, turmeric, gotu kola, Vietnamese mint, Okinawa spinach, culantro; keep it low so the firewood path stays clear.
Plant Sep–Nov; top up chip each autumn.
